title: JM Die financial baseline — train quoting on docustrata + factor date + market prices
trigger: /goal-14 (2026-05-24) — train the quoting portion with JM Die docustrata documents, factor dates + time-frame + market prices of that time → baseline financial analytics for JM. Utilize every piece of document.
leverage_summary: Reuses 12 existing JM Die engines + QuoteOutcomeFeedEngine (just-built) for psi_delta feed + QuotingAccuracyEnhancementEngine for Platt-calibrated forecast confidence. Ingest scope: 301,228 files under H:/PRISM/JM DIE/.

units.title: JMDieDocustrataIngestEngine — walks _PART LIBRARY/<customer>/<part>/<docs>, extracts {customer, part_id, date} from path + filename pattern
units.acceptance: ≥12 tests; parses MM_DD_YYYY HH_MM AM/PM date pattern; handles ENOENT + non-date filenames + adversarial Unicode; returns IngestRecord[] with explicit per-file reason on parse failure

units.title: HistoricalMaterialPriceEngine — date → commodity price lookup (CSV-seeded LME steel/aluminum/copper/stainless monthly avg)
units.acceptance: ≥12 tests; date+material → {price_per_lb, source, month_year}; missing month → nearest-prior fallback with explicit fallback flag (R12); 4-material spanning (steel/Al/Cu/SS)

units.title: JMDieFinancialBaselineEngine — per-customer revenue + per-material spend + per-process margin aggregations
units.acceptance: ≥12 tests; aggregate(records) → {by_customer, by_material, by_process, total_revenue, time_span} with per-customer YoY trend

units.title: JMDieQuoteTrainingPipelineEngine — orchestrates U-JM01 + U-JM02 + QuoteOutcomeFeedEngine. Per-record: ingest → price-at-date → outcome-feed → baseline aggregation
units.acceptance: ≥10 tests; trainBatch(rootDir, limit) returns {processed, baseline, training_summary}; respects --limit; R12 on missing root

units.title: prism_quoting dispatcher — 3 new actions (jm_die_docustrata_ingest, jm_die_historical_material_price, jm_die_financial_baseline) + 1 orchestrator (jm_die_quote_training_pipeline)
units.acceptance: ≥4 dispatcher round-trip tests; schemas zod-validated; lazy imports

units.title: E2E pipeline run on a real JM Die customer subset (≥3 customers from _PART LIBRARY/) — produces a real financial baseline JSON the operator can inspect
units.acceptance: Runs against 3 real customers; output JSON has ≥1 record per customer; baseline includes total_revenue + time_span + per_material spend; R12 on permission-denied / file-corruption (no silent skip)
